lines.text: Amaziah executes the servants who murdered his father but spares their sons, as the Law of Moses says.
Amaziah hires 100,000 mighty men from Moab for a hundred talents of silver, but a man of God warns him.
Amaziah sends the Ephraimites home, then strikes down 10,000 men of Seir in the Valley of the Jordan.
Amaziah worships the gods of the Seirites, then tells the LORD's prophet to stop.
